rules.name: SQL Quote or Inline Comment Signal
rules.note: Soft suspicion signal (+2 < 5): avoids false positives on surnames like O'Brien or D'Angelo.

rules.name: SQL Tautology & Boolean Logic
rules.note: Blocks classic tautologies (' OR '1'='1, OR 1=1) and boolean authentication bypasses.

rules.name: SQL UNION SELECT & Metadata Enumeration
rules.note: Catches UNION-based extraction and metadata schema dumps after comment normalization.

rules.name: Time-Based Blind SQLi & Stacked DDL
rules.note: Catches SLEEP/BENCHMARK timing probes and stacked destructive DDL/DML.

rules.name: XSS Executable HTML Tag / Event Attribute
rules.note: Detects script tags, event-handler injections, and javascript: URIs without tripping on '5 < 10'.

rules.name: Path Traversal & Sensitive System Files
rules.note: Detects directory traversal sequences, null bytes, and Linux/Windows sensitive system files.

rules.name: Automated Scanner User-Agent Signal
rules.note: Soft telemetry (+3 < 5) aligned with multi-signal philosophy: avoids blocking purely on spoofable User-Agent unless combined with suspicious probing.

rules.name: Sensitive Hidden Probe Endpoint
rules.note: Flags scanner enumeration paths; combines with SCN-01 (+3+3=6 >= 5) to block automated Nikto/dirb probes immediately.
